Who is Gordan Garb?

Doctor Gordan Garb was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, this individual was a medical practitioner aboard the . On or about stardate 41044.2, according to an order sent by Commodore Bill Marafe of Starbase 55, this individual was scheduled for a transfer to the . (, okudagram)
